concepts.title: Rotation of the Earth: Day and Night
concepts.definition: Rashmika's shifting shadows hold a clue: the earth spins about its axis once in about 24 hours, so each place turns into sunlight for day and away into darkness for night.
concepts.formula: day + night = one rotation of the earth
concepts.key_idea: Day and night are a dance of rotation: the sun does not rise, the earth turns us towards it.
question_patterns: what causes day and night on the earth
how long does the earth take for one rotation
what is the axis of the earth
why do shadows change length during the day
demonstrate day and night with a globe and lamp
why does the sun appear to move across the sky

concepts.title: Revolution of the Earth and the Seasons
concepts.definition: While spinning, the earth also travels around the sun once in about 365 days; because its axis stays tilted, each hemisphere leans towards or away from the sun in turn, giving the seasons.
concepts.formula: 1 year = 1 revolution of the earth around the sun
concepts.key_idea: Seasons are geometry in motion: a tilted, revolving planet shares sunlight unequally through the year.
question_patterns: what causes the change of seasons on the earth
how long does one revolution of the earth take
why does the axis of the earth stay tilted
why are days longer in summer than in winter
show seasons with a globe moving around a lamp
compare rotation and revolution of the earth

solution_steps.explain: Write the two ideas or groups side by side.
Note the points on which they differ and one point they share.
State in one line what the comparison teaches.

concepts.title: Eclipses: Shadows in the Sky
concepts.definition: Eclipses are shadows on a cosmic scale: when the moon slides into the earth's shadow we see a lunar eclipse, and when the moon's shadow falls on the earth, a solar eclipse darkens a strip of day.
concepts.formula: eclipse = shadow of one body falling on another
concepts.key_idea: An eclipse is geometry caught in the act: sun, moon and earth line up, and a shadow tells the story.
question_patterns: what is a solar eclipse and how does it occur
what is a lunar eclipse and when does it occur
why do eclipses not happen every month

concepts.title: Modelling the Sky with Globe and Shadows
concepts.definition: The chapter's activities turn the sky into a laboratory: globes, lamps and balls model rotation, revolution and eclipse, while shadow records across a day pin down the sun's apparent path.
concepts.key_idea: Models shrink the universe to a tabletop: play with them and the sky's motions become visible sense.
